verses.text: In the fourth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah, king of Judah, Baruch son of Neriah wrote on a scroll the words Jeremiah the prophet dictated. Then Jeremiah gave Baruch this message:
"This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says to you, Baruch:
You said, 'How terrible for me! The LORD has added sorrow to my pain. I am worn out from groaning, and I cannot find rest.'
Tell Baruch, 'This is what the LORD says: Look, I am about to tear down what I have built and pull up what I have planted, throughout the whole land.
Are you looking for great things for yourself? Do not look for them. For I am going to bring disaster on all people, says the LORD. But wherever you go, I will let you escape with your life.'"
